principle_violations.reason: This code violates the Interface Segregation Principle because the CreditPaymentProcessor class is forced to implement the auth_sms method, even though it does not use it.
principle_violations.suggestion: In order to comply with the Interface Segregation Principle create another abstract class (e.g. SMSPaymentProcessor) that implements the auth_sms method and implements the PaymentProcessor class. So the CreditPaymentProcessor can use the PaymentProcessor and the DebitPaymentProcessor can use the SMSPaymentProcessor.
